title: Tourism in space
source: Wikipedia - List of topics in space
executive_summary: Space tourism is human space travel for recreational purposes. There are several different types of space tourism, including orbital, suborbital and lunar space tourism. Tourists are motivated by the possibility of viewing Earth from space, feeling weightlessness, experiencing extremely high speed, and contributing to science.
image_caption: Historical illustration of Tourism in space in outer space.
